prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A clean, minimalist digital illustration designed as a playful infographic. The image features a plain, off-white background with six large, glossy capsules arranged in two rows of three, each pill rendered in a distinct, vibrant color: red and white, blue and white, orange and white, green, yellow and white, and teal and white. Above the pills, bold black text in a modern sans-serif font reads “CHOOSE A PILL.” Each pill is accompanied by a humorous caption in smaller black text, describing a quirky, underwhelming superpower or effect, such as “You can make any soup slightly cooler — but only by waiting 5 minutes” and “Cheese.” The overall composition is symmetrical and balanced, with ample negative space, giving the image a clean, almost clinical feel. The lighting is even and soft, with subtle reflections on the pills to emphasize their glossy, three-dimensional appearance. The style is reminiscent of contemporary flat design with a touch of realism in the pill rendering, evoking the look of a modern advertisement or a satirical magazine illustration.
